inputs.text: City leaders in Phoenix are courageously resisting the federal government's aggressive immigration enforcement, which targets immigrant communities of color and deepens systemic inequalities. The city council approved a plan on Wednesday night that restricts ICE and other law enforcement agencies from using city property. This is a vital step to shield vulnerable families from discriminatory policies rooted in institutional bias and historical exclusion. We urgently need this kind of local resistance to protect labor rights and challenge the broader structures that put enforcement ahead of human dignity.
